items.title: Response from Authors to the Letter to the Editor: Interpreting Per-Protocol Efficacy Signals in a Pilot Trial of Inspiratory Muscle Training
items.summary: This response clarifies methodological points regarding a pilot trial on inspiratory muscle training, particularly on the interpretation of per-protocol efficacy signals.
items.curatedReason: 别被这类作者回复带偏了。虽然作者重申 per-protocol 分析对小样本 IMT 试验有其价值，尤其是在评估干预的“真实”效果时，但这毕竟是一个试点研究的回应，我们不能从中得出任何关于 IMT 实际疗效的新结论。
items.titleZh: 作者对编辑信的回应：如何解读吸气肌训练试点试验中的per-protocol疗效信号
items.summaryZh: 这篇作者回复澄清了一项吸气肌训练（IMT）试点试验的方法学观点，特别是关于 per-protocol 疗效信号的解读。
items.curatedReasonEn: Don't get sidetracked by author responses like this. While the authors re-affirm the value of per-protocol analysis for small-sample IMT trials, especially in assessing the 'true' intervention effect, this is merely a response to a pilot study. We cannot draw any new conclusions about the actual efficacy of IMT from this.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Do Classical Speed-Accuracy Trade-Off Models Generalize to Lower Limb Movements?
items.summary: This preregistered study aims to investigate whether classical speed-accuracy trade-off models generalize to lower limb stepping movements, hypothesizing deviations from Fitts-type scaling under varying instructional emphasis and postural demands in 24 healthy young adults.
items.curatedReason: 这项预注册研究关注 Fitts 定律在下肢运动中的泛化能力，其结果可能改变我们对平衡和步态训练中速度-准确性权衡的理解，进而优化训练方案。
items.titleZh: 经典的速度-准确性权衡模型能否泛化到下肢运动？
items.summaryZh: 这项预注册研究旨在探讨经典的速度-准确性权衡模型能否泛化到下肢踏步运动，假设在不同教学侧重和姿势需求下，24 名健康年轻人会出现与 Fitts 型缩放的偏差。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preregistered study investigates the generalizability of Fitts' law to lower limb movements. Its findings could alter our understanding of speed-accuracy trade-offs in balance and gait training, optimizing intervention protocols.
items.limitation: 这是一项预注册研究，尚未发布最终结果，具体结论待定。
items.limitationEn: This is a preregistered study, and the final results are not yet published, so specific conclusions remain to be seen.

items.title: Rehabilitation of Athletes With Hamstring Strain Injury: SONAFE-Brazil Clinical Practice Guideline.
items.summary: The National Society of Sports Physical Therapy (SONAFE-Brazil) released a clinical practice guideline using the GRADE approach to inform rehabilitation outcomes in athletes with hamstring strain injury, synthesizing evidence from randomized clinical trials.
items.curatedReason: 这份巴西 SONAFE 发布的临床实践指南，为腘绳肌拉伤运动员的康复管理提供了基于 GRADE 证据的明确指导。这是你临床决策的重要依据，尤其在重返运动评估和干预选择上。
items.titleZh: 蕦绳肌拉伤运动员康复：SONAFE-巴西临床实践指南。
items.summaryZh: 巴西运动物理治疗学会 (SONAFE-Brazil) 发布了一项临床实践指南，采用 GRADE 方法，为腘绳肌拉伤运动员的康复结局提供信息，该指南综合了随机临床试验的证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: The SONAFE-Brazil Clinical Practice Guideline offers clear, GRADE-evidence-based recommendations for hamstring strain injury rehabilitation in athletes. This is a crucial resource for your clinical decision-making, especially concerning return-to-sport assessments and intervention choices.
items.limitation: 指南的推荐可能受限于巴西的特定医疗系统和运动文化背景。
items.limitationEn: Guideline recommendations may be influenced by Brazil's specific healthcare system and sports culture.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Reframing hands-on musculoskeletal assessment as a measurement instrument rather than a technique debate: a theoretical framework applying COSMIN to HODA-A.
items.summary: This theoretical paper proposes a framework, HODA-A, for conceptualizing hands-on musculoskeletal examination as a clinician-reported outcome measurement process, aligning with COSMIN principles for construct definition, content validity, examiner calibration, and reliability/validity testing.
items.curatedReason: 本框架将手法评估视为临床报告结果测量工具，而非单纯的技术。这要求我们在评估手法时，需按一套明确的流程来定义、校准、测试可靠性和效度。
items.titleZh: 将肌肉骨骼手法评估重新定义为测量工具而非技术争议：应用 COSMIN 到 HODA-A 的理论框架。
items.summaryZh: 这篇理论文章提出了一个框架 (HODA-A)，将肌肉骨骼手法检查概念化为临床医生报告的结果测量过程，并应用 COSMIN 原则来强调构建定义、内容效度、检查者校准以及可靠性和效度测试的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This framework conceptualizes hands-on assessment as a clinician-reported outcome measure, rather than isolated manual techniques. It highlights the need for a defined sequence of construct definition, calibration, reliability, and validity testing in evaluating manual therapy.
items.limitation: 本研究为理论框架，尚未进行实证验证。
items.limitationEn: This study proposes a theoretical framework and lacks empirical validation.

items.title: Effects of thoracic kinesiological taping on pulmonary functions, respiratory muscle strength, and functional independence in patients with hemiplegia: a randomized controlled clinical trial.
items.summary: In a 30-patient RCT, thoracic kinesiology taping (KT) combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improved pulmonary function (FVC, FEV1, PEF) and inspiratory muscle strength (MIP) in chronic stroke patients, with greater changes in the KT group (all p < 0.001) compared to sham taping.
items.curatedReason: 胸部肌内效贴布（KT）联合常规康复能显著改善慢性卒中患者的肺功能和吸气肌力量，其作用主要通过优化通气力学而非直接肌肉强化实现。可考虑作为神经康复中的实用辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 胸部肌内效贴布对偏瘫患者肺功能、呼吸肌力量及功能独立性的影响：一项随机对照临床试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 30 名患者的随机对照试验显示，胸部肌内效贴布（KT）结合常规康复治疗能显著改善慢性卒中患者的肺功能（FVC、FEV1、PEF）和吸气肌力量（MIP），与假贴布组相比，KT 组的变化更为显著（所有 p < 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Thoracic kinesiology taping (KT) combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improves pulmonary function and inspiratory muscle strength in chronic stroke patients, primarily by optimizing ventilatory mechanics. This suggests it can be a practical adjunct in neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（N=30），随访期短。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (N=30) and a short follow-up period.

items.title: Comparison of kinesio taping and myofascial release therapy in cervicogenic headache: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: An 81-patient RCT showed that both kinesio taping (KT) and myofascial release (MFR) combined with home exercise effectively reduced pain, disability, and headache frequency in cervicogenic headache over 4 weeks. MFR provided more sustained improvements in disability and physical quality of life (p < 0.001) at one-month follow-up compared to KT.
items.curatedReason: 肌内效贴布（KT）和筋膜松弛术（MFR）联合家庭锻炼，对颈源性头痛患者的短期止痛和改善头痛频率均有效，且 MFR 在改善残疾和身体生活质量方面可能提供更持久的益处。这意味着你可以自信地将两者纳入颈源性头痛的多模式康复方案中。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴布与筋膜松弛疗法治疗颈源性头痛的比较：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项 81 名患者的随机对照试验显示，肌内效贴布（KT）和筋膜松弛术（MFR）结合家庭锻炼，在 4 周内均有效减轻了颈源性头痛患者的疼痛、残疾和头痛频率。与 KT 相比，MFR 在一个月随访时在残疾和身体生活质量方面提供了更持久的改善（p < 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Kinesio taping (KT) and myofascial release (MFR), combined with home exercise, are effective for short-term pain relief and headache frequency reduction in cervicogenic headache patients. MFR may offer more sustained benefits for disability and physical quality of life, supporting their confident integration into multimodal rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 研究随访期较短（1 个月），长期效果仍需更多证据。
items.limitationEn: The study has a short follow-up period (1 month), and long-term effects require further evidence.

items.title: An exploration of self-evaluation of induced temporal and spatial gait asymmetry in neurotypical young adults.
items.summary: In 33 neurotypical adults, self-evaluation of temporal gait asymmetry (TGA) was more accurate than spatial gait asymmetry (SGA), with lower odds for correct SGA self-evaluation (OR = 0.09 for presence, 0.18 for direction) compared to TGA. Directing attention to swing time improved TGA self-evaluation (OR = 0.13 for single limb stance vs swing time).
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，在神经正常成人中，时间步态不对称的自我评估比空间不对称更准确，且将注意力引导至摆动相可能有助于提高准确性。这些发现对未来卒中后步态不对称的反馈干预设计有指导意义。
items.titleZh: 神经正常年轻成人对诱发的时间和空间步态不对称的自我评估探索。
items.summaryZh: 对 33 名神经正常成人进行的自我评估研究显示，时间步态不对称 (TGA) 的评估比空间步态不对称 (SGA) 更准确；与 TGA 相比，SGA 自我评估的正确几率较低（存在不对称的 OR = 0.09，方向的 OR = 0.18）。将注意力引向摆动相可提高 TGA 自我评估的准确性（单腿站立与摆动相的 OR = 0.13）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study suggests that neurotypical adults are more accurate in self-evaluating temporal gait asymmetry than spatial asymmetry, and directing attention to the swing phase may improve accuracy. These insights can inform feedback-based interventions for post-stroke gait asymmetry.
items.limitation: 研究对象为神经正常年轻人，结果外推到卒中患者需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted on neurotypical young adults, limiting generalizability to stroke patients.

items.title: Engagement strategies to support sub-acute, post-stroke upper limb interventions: A co-design study.
items.summary: A four-stage co-design study with 30 knowledge-users (stroke survivors, clinicians, scientists) identified 13 engagement themes and synthesized 10 clinician-delivered strategies to support stroke survivor engagement in sub-acute upper limb rehabilitation, emphasizing personalization through timing and emphasis.
items.curatedReason: 这项共同设计研究产出了一套支持卒中患者上肢康复的临床策略，强调个性化（通过时机和强调程度调整）是核心原则。在推广前还需要评估这些策略在临床实践中的可行性。
items.titleZh: 支持亚急性卒中后上肢干预的参与策略：一项协同设计研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 30 名知识使用者（卒中幸存者、临床医生、科学家）的四阶段协同设计研究，识别出 13 个参与主题，并综合了 10 个由临床医生执行的策略，旨在支持亚急性卒中患者参与上肢康复，强调通过时机和强调程度实现个性化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This co-design study developed a suite of clinician-delivered strategies to support stroke survivor engagement in upper limb rehabilitation, highlighting personalization (timing and emphasis) as a core principle. Feasibility in clinical practice needs further testing.
items.limitation: 本研究为共同设计研究，未进行干预实施与效果评估，且在亚急性期进行。
items.limitationEn: This co-design study did not involve intervention delivery or outcome evaluation and focused on the sub-acute phase.

items.title: Methodological quality of systematic reviews on treatments in stroke rehabilitation: A cross-sectional study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study appraised 140 systematic reviews (SRs) on stroke rehabilitation treatments published between 2021-2023, finding only 1.4% to be of high methodological quality. 92.9% were rated as critically low using AMSTAR 2, with Cochrane SRs and those from US/Europe showing higher quality.
items.curatedReason: 对卒中康复治疗系统综述的评估显示，其方法学质量普遍不佳，92.9% 被评为“极低质量”。这意味着你在查阅文献时，需要对现有综述的证据可靠性保持高度警惕，并优先选择 Cochrane 综述或由欧美团队主导、高影响因子期刊发表的研究。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复治疗系统综述的方法学质量：一项横断面研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究评估了 2021-2023 年间发表的 140 篇卒中康复治疗系统综述，发现仅 1.4% 的综述方法学质量高。使用 AMSTAR 2 评估，92.9% 的综述被评为极低质量，其中 Cochrane 综述和来自美国/欧洲的综述质量较高。
items.curatedReasonEn: The methodological quality of systematic reviews (SRs) on stroke rehabilitation treatments is largely unsatisfactory, with 92.9% rated as "critically low quality." This means you should exercise extreme caution when relying on existing SRs and prioritize Cochrane reviews or those led by US/European authors and published in high-impact journals.
items.limitation: 研究结果依赖于 AMSTAR 2 评估工具，可能存在评价者主观性。
items.limitationEn: The study's findings rely on the AMSTAR 2 assessment tool, which may introduce subjective bias.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Is Reduced Spinal Range of Motion a Prognostic Factor for Pain Intensity, Disability, and Global Recovery in People With Specific or Nonspecific Spinal Pain? A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review of 37 studies found very low certainty evidence that it is unclear whether reduced spinal range of motion independently predicts pain intensity, disability, or global recovery in people with specific or nonspecific spinal pain.
items.curatedReason: 脊柱活动度下降是否能预测脊柱疼痛患者的疼痛强度、残疾和整体恢复？证据的确定性极低，当前尚不清楚这两者之间是否存在独立预测关系。切勿过度依赖活动度作为核心预后指标。
items.titleZh: 脊柱活动度下降是否是特异性或非特异性脊柱疼痛患者疼痛强度、残疾和整体恢复的预后因素？一项系统综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 37 项研究的系统综述发现，证据确定性极低，尚不清楚脊柱活动度下降是否能独立预测特异性或非特特异性脊柱疼痛患者的疼痛强度、残疾和整体恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: Does reduced spinal range of motion predict pain intensity, disability, and global recovery in individuals with spinal pain? The certainty of evidence is very low, and it remains unclear if an independent prognostic relationship exists. Avoid over-reliance on ROM as a primary prognostic indicator.
items.limitation: 纳入研究普遍存在高偏倚风险，且结果异质性高，导致证据确定性极低。
items.limitationEn: Included studies consistently had a high risk of bias and high heterogeneity in results, leading to a very low certainty of evidence.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Dextrose prolotherapy for chronic symptomatic rotator cuff tendinopathy and subacromial bursitis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 studies (13 RCTs, 1 observational) found very low certainty evidence that dextrose prolotherapy may have little to no benefit for chronic symptomatic mixed rotator cuff tendinopathy and/or subacromial bursitis, and may result in worse physical performance compared to corticosteroid injections.
items.curatedReason: 关于右旋糖增生疗法治疗肩袖肌腱病和滑囊炎，证据质量极低，总体效果不确定。在短期到中期，它可能几乎没有益处，而且与皮质类固醇注射相比，可能会导致更差的身体表现。在常规临床实践中，目前证据不足以支持将其作为一线治疗。
items.titleZh: 右旋糖增生疗法治疗慢性症状性肩袖肌腱病和肩峰下滑囊炎：一项系统综述和 Meta 分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 14 项研究（13 项随机对照试验，1 项观察性研究）进行的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，对于慢性症状性混合型肩袖肌腱病和/或肩峰下滑囊炎，右旋糖增生疗法可能几乎没有益处（与生理盐水相比），且与皮质类固醇注射相比，可能导致更差的身体表现；证据确定性极低。
items.curatedReasonEn: For dextrose prolotherapy in rotator cuff tendinopathy and subacromial bursitis, the evidence is very uncertain and suggests little to no benefit compared to saline, and potentially worse physical performance compared to corticosteroid injections. Current evidence is insufficient to support its routine use as a primary intervention.
items.limitation: 本综述包含的研究普遍存在高偏倚风险和样本量小的问题，且研究异质性高，影响了证据的确定性。
items.limitationEn: The included studies generally had a high risk of bias, small sample sizes, and high heterogeneity, limiting the certainty of evidence.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Patients' experiences of participating in physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction; a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 14 women in Sweden found that telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction was perceived as a complementary approach, improving accessibility and continuity of care, despite concerns about the absence of physical examination and hands-on guidance.
items.curatedReason: 远程康复被患者视为产后盆底功能障碍物理治疗的有效补充，提高了可及性和依从性。尽管存在对缺乏体格检查和人际互动的担忧，但混合模式的护理可能是未来的方向。
items.titleZh: 产后盆底功能障碍患者参与物理治疗远程康复的经验：一项定性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项对瑞典 14 名女性的定性研究发现，产后盆底功能障碍患者认为远程康复是物理治疗的有效补充，提高了可及性和护理的连续性，但同时对缺乏体格检查和手把手指导表示担忧。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patients perceive telerehabilitation as a valuable complement to in-person physical therapy for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction, enhancing accessibility and adherence. While concerns exist about the lack of physical examination and interpersonal interaction, a hybrid care model could be a future direction.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（14 名参与者），结果的普遍性和推论性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study had a small sample size (14 participants), limiting the generalizability and inferential power of its findings.

items.title: First aggression as a planning signal in post-acute stroke rehabilitation: Service benchmarks, goal setting, and a 60-day precaution window from a comprehensive observational cohort.
items.summary: A retrospective observational cohort study (N=1683) found that the first electronic health record-documented aggression after stroke signals longer length of stay (+17.9 days) and lower functional independence measure (mFIM) efficiency/effectiveness, warranting a 60-day precaution window for rehabilitation planning.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后首次出现攻击性行为是重要的康复规划信号。患者住院时间平均延长 17.9 天，功能独立性评分（mFIM）效率和有效性更低，需要设定更现实的康复目标和出院时间。首次事件后 60 天内是重要的预警窗口。
items.titleZh: 首次攻击行为作为卒中急性后期康复的规划信号：来自一项综合观察队列的服务基准、目标设定和 60 天预警期。
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性观察队列研究（N=1683）发现，卒中后首次电子健康记录记录的攻击行为是一个规划信号：其发生率（2.83/1000 患者日）提示 30 天和 60 天风险分别为 8.1% 和 15.6%，与非攻击性患者相比，住院时间平均延长 17.9 天，功能独立性评分（mFIM）效率和有效性更低，提示需要设定更现实的康复目标和出院时间。
items.curatedReasonEn: The first aggressive behavior after stroke is a critical signal for rehabilitation planning. These patients face an average 17.9-day longer LOS and lower mFIM efficiency and effectiveness, necessitating realistic goal setting and discharge updates. A 60-day precaution window is justified after the first event.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心回顾性观察队列研究，存在潜在偏倚，且数据来自日本的一个农村县，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective observational cohort study with potential for bias, and data from a rural prefecture in Japan may limit generalizability.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Association between hospital-level factors and early rehabilitation initiation in patients with acute ischemic stroke: a multilevel analysis using a Japanese administrative database from a rural prefecture.
items.summary: A multilevel analysis of 17,194 patients with acute ischemic stroke in Japan found that provision of weekend rehabilitation services was significantly associated with early rehabilitation initiation (incidence rate ratio 1.65), while therapist staffing levels and stroke volume were not.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后早期康复的启动率在不同医院间存在显著差异，其中周末康复服务是主要影响因素。考虑在你所在的机构推行周末康复，以提高急性缺血性卒中患者的早期康复可及性。
items.titleZh: 医院层面因素与急性缺血性卒中患者早期康复启动的关联：一项使用日本农村地区管理数据库的多水平分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项对日本 17,194 名急性缺血性卒中患者的多水平分析发现，提供周末康复服务与早期康复启动显著相关（发生率比 1.65），而治疗师人员配备和卒中年收治量则无关联；这表明早期康复启动的差异主要由组织系统而非患者特征驱动。
items.curatedReasonEn: The initiation rate of early rehabilitation after stroke varies significantly across hospitals, with weekend rehabilitation services being a key factor. Consider advocating for weekend rehabilitation in your institution to improve access for patients with acute ischemic stroke.
items.limitation: 本研究为多中心横断面研究，数据来自日本一个农村县的 19 家医院，可能限制其在不同医疗系统和地理区域的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This multicenter cross-sectional study's data came from 19 hospitals in a rural prefecture in Japan, which may limit generalizability to different healthcare systems and geographic regions.

items.title: Mirror therapy versus functional electrical stimulation cycling in post-stroke lower limb rehabilitation: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: An RCT comparing mirror therapy (MT) and functional electrical stimulation-assisted cycling (FES-C) as adjuncts to conventional rehabilitation for subacute stroke found both effective, with greater improvements in FMA-LE scores compared to control (MT: MD -2.60, p=0.004; FES-C: MD -3.00, p=0.008), and FES-C also significantly improved Brunnstrom stage and SS-QOL.
items.curatedReason: 对于亚急性卒中患者，镜像疗法（MT）和功能性电刺激辅助骑行（FES-C）均可作为传统康复的有效补充，显著改善下肢运动功能；其中 FES-C 还额外提高了 Brunnstrom 分期和生活质量。
items.titleZh: 镜像疗法与功能性电刺激循环在卒中下肢康复中的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验比较了镜像疗法（MT）和功能性电刺激辅助循环（FES-C）作为亚急性卒中常规康复的辅助手段，结果显示两者均有效，且在 FMA-LE 评分方面优于对照组（MT：MD -2.60，p=0.004；FES-C：MD -3.00，p=0.008），FES-C 还在 Brunnstrom 分期和 SS-QOL 上有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT demonstrates that both mirror therapy (MT) and functional electrical stimulation-assisted cycling (FES-C) are effective adjuncts to conventional rehabilitation for subacute stroke, leading to greater improvements in lower extremity motor function and quality of life compared to control. While both were effective, FES-C showed additional significant gains in Brunnstrom stage and quality of life.
items.limitation: The study had a relatively small sample size (n=15 per group) and a 6-week intervention period, potentially limiting long-term outcome assessment.
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size (n=15 per group) and a 6-week intervention period, potentially limiting long-term outcome assessment.

items.title: The enhanced rehabilitation programme for significant musculoskeletal injuries from the manchester arena bombing - A process evaluation study investigating patients' and physiotherapists' experiences.
items.summary: A process evaluation of the Enhanced Rehabilitation Programme (ERP) for major trauma survivors found it beneficial for physical and psychological recovery, though participants noted challenges with long-term sustainability and transition back to standard NHS care, suggesting resource limitations and systemic constraints as adoption barriers.
items.curatedReason: 重大创伤幸存者康复项目（ERP）对身心恢复有益，但其长期可持续性和回归常规照护的挑战，提示了资源和系统层面的阻碍。
items.titleZh: 曼彻斯特体育场爆炸重大肌肉骨骼损伤的增强康复计划——一项调查患者和物理治疗师体验的过程评估研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对曼彻斯特体育场爆炸重大创伤事件后增强康复计划（ERP）的过程评估发现，该计划对身心康复有益，但参与者指出了维持进展和过渡回标准NHS护理的挑战，提示更广泛推广面临资源和系统性制约。
items.curatedReasonEn: This process evaluation of the Enhanced Rehabilitation Programme (ERP) after the Manchester Arena bombing reveals that patients and physiotherapists viewed it positively for supporting physical and psychological recovery. However, it also highlights challenges in sustaining progress and transitioning back to standard NHS care, indicating potential barriers to wider adoption.
items.limitation: The study involved a small number of participants (13 patients, 4 physiotherapists) and focused on experiences rather than objective outcomes.
items.limitationEn: The study involved a small number of participants (13 patients, 4 physiotherapists) and focused on experiences rather than objective outcomes.

items.title: Not Just Faster Horses: Telerehabilitation as a Necessary Evolution in Physical Therapy.
items.summary: An editorial proposes telerehabilitation as an essential evolution for musculoskeletal physical therapy, advocating for its integration to extend clinician roles through continuous monitoring and engagement, rather than merely as an alternative to conventional care.
items.curatedReason: 别把远程康复当成线下治疗的替代品，它必须被整合，以拓展我们监控和参与患者的能力。
items.titleZh: 不止于更快的马匹：远程康复是物理治疗的必然演进
items.titleEn: Not Just Faster Horses: Telerehabilitation as a Necessary Evolution in Physical Therapy
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论将骨骼肌肉物理治疗的数字化转型比作从“更快的马匹”到汽车的转变，主张远程康复是物理治疗的必然演进，应整合技术以延伸治疗师的角色，而非取代。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial argues for telerehabilitation as a necessary evolution in musculoskeletal physical therapy, moving beyond traditional in-person sessions to incorporate continuous monitoring and patient engagement through digital tools. It emphasizes the need for clinicians to adapt their skills and habits to integrate technology while preserving therapeutic relationships.
items.limitation: This is an editorial, not based on new empirical data.
items.limitationEn: This is an editorial, not based on new empirical data.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Diagnostic Performance of Ultrasonographic Median Nerve Cross-Sectional Area for Carpal Tunnel Syndrome in Wheelchair Users With Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: A diagnostic accuracy study found ultrasonographic median nerve cross-sectional area (CSA-M) has moderate performance (AuROC 0.76) for carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS) in wheelchair users with spinal cord injury, with a 10 mm² cutoff showing 90.5% sensitivity and a 15 mm² cutoff showing 91.7% specificity.
items.curatedReason: 在脊髓损伤的轮椅使用者中，超声检查尺神经横截面积（CSA-M）对腕管综合征（CTS）的诊断有中等准确性（AuROC 0.76），特定截断值（10 mm² 或 15 mm²）可分别侧重敏感性或特异性。
items.titleZh: 超声诊断脊髓损伤轮椅使用者腕管综合征的神经横截面积的诊断性能
items.summaryZh: 一项诊断准确性研究发现，在脊髓损伤轮椅使用者中，超声测量神经横截面积（CSA-M）用于诊断腕管综合征（CTS）具有中等性能（AuROC 0.76），其中 10 mm² 截断值为 90.5% 敏感性，15 mm² 截断值为 91.7% 特异性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This diagnostic accuracy study in wheelchair users with spinal cord injury found that ultrasonographic median nerve cross-sectional area (CSA-M) has moderate diagnostic performance for carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS), with different cutoffs favoring sensitivity or specificity. This offers a potentially useful, though not definitive, tool for clinicians assessing CTS in this specific population.
items.limitation: The study's findings are specific to wheelchair users with spinal cord injury, limiting generalizability to other populations.
items.limitationEn: The study's findings are specific to wheelchair users with spinal cord injury, limiting generalizability to other populations.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: "It's a black box": Physiotherapists' perspectives on sensorimotor control and the use of technology in this context to improve rehabilitation following ACL injury.
items.summary: A qualitative study of physiotherapists revealed a demand for measurable indicators of movement quality and interest in technology for assessing and rehabilitating sensorimotor control after ACL injury, but limited adoption due to unclear clinical value and integration challenges.
items.curatedReason: 物理治疗师们渴望量化运动质量指标，并对用于评估和康复ACL损伤后感觉运动控制的技术感兴趣，但由于临床价值不明和整合困难，目前接受度不高。
items.titleZh: “这是一个黑匣子”：物理治疗师对感觉运动控制及在此背景下利用技术改善前交叉韧带损伤后康复的看法
items.summaryZh: 一项针对物理治疗师的定性研究显示，他们渴望可衡量的运动质量指标，并对利用技术评估和康复前交叉韧带（ACL）损伤后的感觉运动控制感兴趣，但因临床价值不明确和整合挑战而限制了技术采纳。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights physiotherapists' desire for measurable indicators of movement quality and their interest in technology for assessing and rehabilitating sensorimotor control after ACL injury. However, uncertainty about the clinical value of sensorimotor outcomes and the integration of technology currently limits adoption.
items.limitation: This study is qualitative and relies on physiotherapists' perspectives, not objective measures of technology effectiveness.
items.limitationEn: This study is qualitative and relies on physiotherapists' perspectives, not objective measures of technology effectiveness.

items.title: Absolute Test-Retest Reliability of the Sit-And-Reach Tests in Healthy Individuals: A Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analysis found that absolute test-retest reliability of sit-and-reach tests in healthy individuals varies, with pooled estimates indicating moderate to good reliability depending on the specific test protocol.
items.curatedReason: 对健康个体而言，坐立前屈测试的重测信度（absolute test-retest reliability）在不同方案下表现从中等到良好不等，这项系统评价和荟萃分析结果对理解其测量属性有参考价值。
items.titleZh: 健康个体坐姿体前屈测试的绝对重测信度：一项系统性回顾与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统性回顾与荟萃分析表明，健康个体坐姿体前屈测试的绝对重测信度各异，汇总估计根据具体测试方案显示从中等到良好的信度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review with meta-analysis synthesizes evidence on the absolute test-retest reliability of sit-and-reach tests in healthy individuals. While valuable for understanding measurement properties, it doesn't directly alter clinical practice without specific context on its application to PT populations.
items.limitation: The review focuses on healthy individuals, and findings may not directly translate to patient populations with varying flexibility and movement impairments.
items.limitationEn: The review focuses on healthy individuals, and findings may not directly translate to patient populations with varying flexibility and movement impairments.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Quantifying Static Postural Control Impairment after Stroke using Markerless Motion Capture
items.summary: A study using markerless motion capture found it effective for quantifying static postural control impairment in 46% of individuals with subacute stroke, with results correlating strongly with clinical balance and functional scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项无标记动作捕捉技术能有效评估亚急性期中风患者的静态姿势控制能力，46%的患者存在功能障碍，结果与临床评分高度相关，可用于临床。
items.titleZh: 利用无标记运动捕捉量化卒中后静态姿势控制损伤
items.summaryZh: 一项利用无标记运动捕捉技术的研究发现，该技术能够有效量化亚急性卒中患者的静态姿势控制损伤，其中 46% 的参与者被诊断为存在损伤。研究结果与临床平衡和功能评分高度相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Markerless motion capture is effective for quantifying static postural control impairment in individuals with subacute stroke, with 46% of participants identified as impaired. The method correlates well with clinical balance and functional scores, suggesting its utility in clinical settings.
items.limitation: This study focused only on static postural control and should be extended to dynamic tasks and gait.
items.limitationEn: This study focused only on static postural control and should be extended to dynamic tasks and gait.

items.title: Rehabilitation after stroke for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and Indigenous peoples globally: a scoping review and critical content analysis.
items.summary: A scoping review of 108 sources indicates that stroke rehabilitation for Indigenous peoples is influenced by colonization and Western healthcare dominance; future research should focus on self-determined rehabilitation aligned with Indigenous worldviews.
items.curatedReason: 一项范围界定性综述表明，原住民群体中风后康复受到殖民化和西方医疗主导地位的影响；未来的研究应侧重于符合原住民世界观的自主康复。
items.titleZh: 原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民以及全球原住民群体中风后康复：范围界定性综述和批判性内容分析
items.summaryZh: 一项范围界定性综述表明，原住民群体中风后康复受到殖民化和西方医疗主导地位的影响；未来的研究应侧重于符合原住民世界观的自主康复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review highlights that stroke rehabilitation for Indigenous peoples is significantly impacted by colonization, racism, and Western healthcare dominance. It calls for a shift towards self-determined, culturally aligned rehabilitation practices, emphasizing the need for deeper understanding and delinking from colonial approaches.
items.limitation: This scoping review is limited by the extent and foci of the existing literature.
items.limitationEn: This scoping review is limited by the extent and foci of the existing literature.

items.title: Return to sports after lumbar disc herniation surgery: a survey of German surgeons and postoperative patient experiences.
items.summary: A survey of German surgeons revealed varied recommendations for returning to sports after lumbar disc herniation surgery, with most suggesting 8 weeks, while patient data indicated actual return at 12.1 weeks, highlighting a need for evidence-based guidelines.
items.curatedReason: 德国外科医生对腰椎间盘突出术后重返运动的建议不尽一致，且远早于患者实际恢复时间。临床应尽快制定基于证据的指南。
items.titleZh: 腰椎间盘突出症术后重返运动：对德国外科医生的一项调查及术后患者体验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对德国外科医生的调查显示，腰椎间盘突出症术后重返运动的建议差异很大，大多数建议 8 周，而患者数据显示实际重返时间为 12.1 周，这凸显了对循证指南的需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: Surgeons' recommendations for returning to sports after lumbar disc herniation surgery vary widely and lack strong evidence. Patient-reported return to sport appears to be later than advised, suggesting a need for prospective studies to establish evidence-based guidelines.
items.limitation: The datasets are not directly comparable due to differences in survey design and setting.
items.limitationEn: The datasets are not directly comparable due to differences in survey design and setting.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Effect of Short-Rest Interval versus Traditional Multiple-Set Resistance Training Combined with Endurance Training in Patients with Cardiovascular Disease: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial found that short-rest interval resistance training (3/7 RT) improved quadriceps strength more than traditional multiple-set resistance training (3x9 RT) in patients with cardiovascular disease undergoing cardiac rehabilitation, with similar improvements in VO₂peak and other measures.
items.curatedReason: 心脏康复中，短间歇（3/7）抗阻训练在股四头肌力量提升方面优于传统（3x9）模式，但VO₂peak等其他指标无显著差异，两者皆可使用。
items.titleZh: 短间歇组与传统多组阻力训练结合耐力训练对心血管疾病患者的效果：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机临床试验发现，对于接受心脏康复治疗的心血管疾病患者，短间歇组阻力训练（3/7 RT）比传统多组阻力训练（3×9 RT）更能提高股四头肌力量，同时在最大摄氧量和其他指标上改善相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both short-rest interval and traditional resistance training are feasible and effective in cardiac rehabilitation. While quadriceps strength improved more with the short-rest protocol, overall outcomes for VO₂peak, sit-to-stand, and lean mass were similar, suggesting either modality can be used clinically, considering patient preference.
items.limitation: The study involved a supervised cardiac rehabilitation program, and findings may not generalize to unsupervised settings.
items.limitationEn: The study involved a supervised cardiac rehabilitation program, and findings may not generalize to unsupervised settings.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Correction
items.summary: A correction notice for a systematic review on vagus nerve stimulation in stroke rehabilitation corrects a data entry error in Table 3, adjusting a sample size from 184 to 192.
items.curatedReason: 这项关于迷走神经刺激治疗中风康复的系统评价，仅修正了表格3中的一项样本量录入错误（184改为192），对结论无影响。
items.titleZh: 勘误
items.summaryZh: 针对一篇关于迷走神经刺激促进中风康复的系统评价，此勘误通知指出了其中表 3 的数据录入错误，将某亚组的样本量从 184 修正为 192。

items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of iTBS and rTMS Combined with Robotic Rehabilitation on Ambulation and Lower Extremity Motor Function in Chronic SCI Patients.
items.summary: A single-blind RCT (n=30) found that both rTMS and iTBS combined with robotic rehabilitation improved lower-extremity motor function (LEMS: rTMS median +4.0, iTBS +5.0 vs sham +0.0; SCIM III: rTMS +3.0, iTBS +5.0 vs sham +0.0) and ambulation (10 MWT: rTMS +6.6, iTBS +5.7 vs sham +0.7) in chronic incomplete SCI patients at 4-week follow-up, with no significant differences between active groups.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性不完全性脊髓损伤患者，rTMS 和 iTBS 结合机器人康复均能改善下肢功能和步态，且两种主动干预方案之间无显著差异。这提示将这些神经调控技术纳入康复方案，但需注意在不同结局指标上与安慰剂组的差异性表现。
items.titleZh: iTBS 和 rTMS 结合机器人康复对慢性脊髓损伤患者步态和下肢运动功能的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲随机对照试验（n=30）发现，rTMS 和 iTBS 结合机器人康复在 4 周随访期能改善慢性不完全性脊髓损伤患者的下肢运动功能（LEMS: rTMS 中位数 +4.0，iTBS +5.0，安慰剂 +0.0；SCIM III: rTMS +3.0，iTBS +5.0，安慰剂 +0.0）和步态（10 米步行测试: rTMS +6.6，iTBS +5.7，安慰剂 +0.7），且两主动干预组间无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic incomplete SCI patients, both rTMS and iTBS combined with robotic rehabilitation improved lower-extremity function and ambulation, with no significant differences between the two active interventions. This suggests incorporating these neuromodulation techniques into rehabilitation, but note the varied performance compared to sham across different outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心、单盲试验，样本量较小（每组10人），且未观察到两种主动协议之间的显著差异。
items.limitationEn: This study was a single-center, single-blind trial with a small sample size (10 participants per group), and no significant differences were observed between the two active protocols.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Shear wave elastography for assessing lower extremity muscle stiffness after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: A systematic review.
items.summary: A systematic review of 6 studies (173 ACLR participants) found reduced passive vastus medialis shear modulus in operative limbs (Hedges' g -1.10 to -1.21 vs controls), associated with quadriceps strength, knee function, and landing biomechanics. Semitendinosus stiffness was reduced after hamstring tendon harvest (g -1.29 to -1.64).
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述肯定了剪切波弹性成像（SWE）在 ACLR 术后评估股内侧肌和半腱肌刚度缺陷的潜力。对于术后力量达标但运动模式仍有异常的患者，SWE 或能提供超越肌力评估的机械解释，支持更精准的康复干预，特别是股内侧肌和腘绳肌供区。
items.titleZh: 剪切波弹性成像评估前交叉韧带重建术后下肢肌肉僵硬度的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 6 项研究（173 名 ACLR 受试者）的系统综述发现，手术肢体股内侧肌的被动剪切模量降低（Hedges' g -1.10 至 -1.21 对照组），这与股四头肌力量、膝关节功能和着陆生物力学相关。半腱肌刚度在腘绳肌腱取后降低（g -1.29 至 -1.64）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review affirms the potential of shear wave elastography (SWE) in assessing vastus medialis and semitendinosus stiffness deficits after ACLR. For patients who meet strength benchmarks but still exhibit abnormal movement patterns, SWE may offer mechanical explanations beyond strength assessment, supporting more precise rehabilitation interventions, especially for the vastus medialis and hamstring donor site.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的质量从差到好不等，且各研究协议标准化程度低，缺乏对特定临床相关区域的采样，限制了 SWE 在康复指导中的直接应用。
items.limitationEn: The quality of included studies ranged from poor to good, and protocols were not standardized, lacking sampling of specific clinically relevant regions, which limits the direct application of SWE in guiding rehabilitation.
